$comment: Contract of `appsec-rules validate --format json`, format marker appsec-rules-validation/v1. Fields may be added within v1; removing or renaming one, or changing an issue code, requires v2. See VERSIONING.md.
title: AppSec Rules Pack validation report

ok.description: The gate verdict. false when errors exist, or warnings exist and --fail-on-warnings was set. The exit code agrees with it.

path.description: Path relative to the argument it was found under, with forward slashes; the file name when the argument was the file.

code.description: Stable identifier of the kind of issue.

rule_id.description: Id of the rule the issue belongs to, or null.

path.description: Dotted location inside the pack, or <root>.

line.description: 1-based line of the path in the file, or of the closest part of it the file contains; null when the issue has no location. Added in 0.9.0.

column.description: 1-based column that goes with line. Added in 0.9.0.

message.description: Human-readable text. It may be reworded between releases; match on code instead.

error.description: Present only when no rule files were found; summary.ok is then false.
